decision.title: XSD conformance sweep 3: XSD 1.1 component rules, content recovery (packet )
decision.summary: The XSD sweep fixes 21 cases by XSD 1.1 component rules and adds , so after a rejected child the validator goes on matching the rest of the content.

body.p: , after , , , , , . No public header changed; internal additions only (schema_internal.h: sxml_schema_value_constraints_are_equal, sxml_schema_content_model_recover, sxml_schema_type_definition.restricts_attribute_group; schema_read_internal.h: sxml_schema_document_reference.needs_document; the validation frame's is_after_rejection).

item.p: Start (release sxml-xsd-test, whole run at 7277563): 41,486 of 41,518 in scope passed, 32 failed, 217 not run.

Fixed, 21, by what XSD 1.1 decides (commit 3b037b0): src-attribute.5, fixed with use="prohibited" (4; QUEUE had it as a 1.0-only rule, but 3.2.3 clause 5 is new in 1.1); an attribute's type must be simple, src-resolve (1); a required base attribute keeps a use in the restriction's {attribute uses}, and the restriction that checks a redefined attribute group inherits none (2); src-redefine.1, a redefine with components whose document does not resolve (4); simple content restricting xs:anySimpleType or xs:anyAtomicType without facets, cos-st-restricts.1.1 (4); fixed values in restrictions compare as values, equal or identical (1); Element Declarations Consistent, wildcard paragraph: type tables of a local declaration and the top-level one a strict or lax wildcard matches (3); a restricting wildcard the union of the base's wildcards covers (1); xml:lang of schema documents is a language or empty (1). End: 41,507 passed, 11 failed, none lost; the slice 147/147.
Left, 11, not decided by XSD 1.1 as the tests expect:

XSD 1.0 rules: particlesK006 (1.0's particle restriction; 1.1's is by language), particlesZ033_g (UPA between an element and a wildcard, allowed in 1.1, 3.8.6.4's note), annotF001 (xml:lang="" is invalid only with the 2001 xml.xsd).
Against the 1.1 Rec: ibm s3_4_2_4si03 expects a circular attribute group reference to be an error; 3.6.2.1 says it is not.

xs:NOTATION used directly (github w3c/xsdtests issue 12): 1.1 makes validating a literal against xs:NOTATION the error; keeps it a schema error, as MHK's 2026 revision of over027 does. Then particlesZ007 (schema valid, 2006) and particlesZ007.i fail, and so does over027.n01, whose schema is (rightly, by that reading) invalid while the instance test expects a verdict.

Instance tests of indeterminate schemas: schU3.i, schU4.i, schU5.i (a document redefined twice, bug 4136) and ste110.i (a circular union, bug 4957, queried): sxml rejects the schema, the instance tests expect "invalid", and the driver counts an instance of a failed schema as a fail ().
XML 1.1 instances, named in QUEUE: none fail now; they are not run (XML-1.1 is not a supported substrate token).

Not run (217): the introspection set (92) validates the suite's own catalogs against xsts.xsd, which imports http://www.w3.org/XML/2008/06/xlink.xsd; with a local copy of that file all 92 pass (measured with sxml validate). Cheap to run: the driver's resolver would serve that one file, as the stand-in xml.xsd is served (); it needs xlink.xsd in third_party, for the owner. "queried" (57): run as an experiment, 27 pass; their expectations are the ones the WG queried, so they stay out. "version 1.0" (50): XSD 1.0 behaviour, not an XSD 1.1 processor's; not cheap to judge, stay out. The rest (indeterminate 14, none applies 2, disputed 1, Unicode 4.0.0 1) have no expectation to compare with.

Content recovery ('s and 's open item; commit 707ca3a; glossary content_recovery): after a child the content model rejects (cvc-complex-type.2.4), the validator moves to the nearest state the child is accepted from, as if the elements before it were missing (a breadth-first walk over the states, an explicit queue, ; counter tests not applied on the way), or else skips the child and assesses it by a declaration of its name in the type's particles (else laxly); the rest of the content goes on being matched and checked. A missing element is one report, an extra one one, a swap two; "incomplete" is not repeated right after a rejection at the same state. Verdicts do not change (no attribution after the rejected child, 3.4.4.2); empty, simple and nilled content keep the lax rest. The book's XSD chapters and apps/sxml/README.md show it.

xsi:schemaLocation in sxml validate: not added. The library does not follow schema location hints (schema.h: "not followed (4.3.2 allows it)"; fn:xsd-validator's use-xsi-schema-location=true is FODC0009), so a flag would name something that does not work (CLI rules). The book's "Schema hints in documents" stands. Following hints needs the validator to add documents to its schema while it validates (hints may appear on any element), which is a design packet.
IDREF checks at an element validation root stay ().

Measured (release drivers, before/after each change): XSD11 41,486 -> 41,507; QT4 XQ40 schema-aware sets (77 test sets with schemaValidation, schemaImport, typedData or xsd-validator) 11,977 passed, 57 failed, unchanged; XT40 schema_aware sets (52) 4,083 passed, 87 failed, unchanged; no case changed outcome. CONFORMANCE.md is not regenerated.
